fields.name: braidEpoch
fields.rule: u64be 1..18446744073709551614; control key epoch is braidEpoch-1

fields.name: controlCounter
fields.rule: u8 1 or 2; exact owned counter/replay binding is not supplied by parsing

fields.name: publicBraidPayload
fields.rule: exact kind length from payloadKinds; existing DTR2 logical payload, not a DTR2 record

fields.name: authenticator
fields.rule: unverified HMAC-SHA-256 tag; parsing never authenticates it

authenticationInput.rule: UTF8(domain) || zero:u8 || canonical DBR2 projection of tags1..10; rebuild fieldCount=10, retain exact padding, omit tag11 without placeholder
authenticationInput.keyDerivation: braid-recovery-v2.native.registry.json#controlKdf; internal component candidate, not durable/transport activation

activationRule: codec only; no authority, author/verifier, native mutation, control dispatch/ACK or runtime activation
